verses.text: Hollow and deceptive philosophy . . . depends on human tradition and the elemental spiritual forces of this world rather than on Christ.
verses.title: Not Ritual but Christ

verses.text: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight, so that you may be able to discern what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
